feeds.title: Ari's Bass Blog
feeds.description: Ari's skills and experiences as a performer as well as an educator make him an asset for situations where musical performance and training are used in traditional contexts, such as stage, studio, classrooms, and Universities, as well as not-so-traditional contexts such as corporations, agencies, and organizations. Ari uses musical experiences as metaphors for leadership, positive change, and the deepening of life experiences. Ari's Bass Blog features practice hacks, tips and tricks, deep thoughts, bass videos, educational content, games, fun and more!

feeds.title: eBassGuitar Blog
feeds.description: Bass guitar lesson videos for beginner to intermediate bassists. Started by James Eager in 2016, bass guitar's number one job is to help you become a gig-ready, confident bassist. Regardless of whether you're just starting out or a seasoned player wanting to revisit and build on basics - there's something for you.

feeds.title: Howard Bass Head Blog
feeds.description: Howard has extensive experience in live music. Whilst at university he played with everyone he could, including at one point playing with over ten bands! He also ended up playing at his graduation ceremony in G Live, Guildford. Howard has also had great experiences with function bands and regularly performs at weddings and various private events.

feeds.title: StudyBass Says
feeds.description: Learn about new bass lessons and tools as they are posted on StudyBass.com. Learn to play bass at StudyBass! StudyBass is a free online course for bass players designed by experienced bass teacher Andrew Pouska. Not everything fits in a lesson or gear article. Posts on music topics, learning, site updates and more.

feeds.title: Bass Musician Magazine
feeds.description: Since 2007, Bass Musician Magazine has been a free online bass magazine and social media outreach speaking directly to tech-savvy bass players, gear enthusiasts and industry professionals around the world. Exclusively online, sporting a mobile responsive design suited to desktop, tablet or mobile devices, BMM offers readers a way to get their daily bass fix on the go.

feeds.title: Andertons Blog » Bass Guitars
feeds.description: We have all the latest in Guitar, Pro Audio and Drum equipment, as well as some great deals! We've been around since 1964 and still remain a family-run business. If you prefer your strings thick and your notes low, look no further than the bass guitar section of the Andertons blog! Interviews, articles and guides on all-things-bass-guitar what more could you ask for?

feeds.title: No Treble
feeds.description: The online magazine for bass players, includes bass lessons, new gear, expert columns, news, bass videos, and more. We're here to discuss the latest bass news and all things bass. This online magazine is for bass players, including bass lessons, new gear, expert columns, news, bass videos, and more.

feeds.title: Bass Gear Magazine
feeds.description: Bass Gear Magazine is your source for the most thorough, detailed, and objective reviews of all gear related to bass guitar and double bass, with independent bench testing, live use, interviews with manufacturers and comparisons to competing products. BGM features factory tours, trade show coverage, in-depth interviews, and regular columns, like David Ellefson's Metal-on-Metal and the Luthiers Round Table.

feeds.title: Double Bass HQ
feeds.description: Jason Heath's Double Bass Blog has connected tens of thousands of musicians worldwide. With nearly 4,000 articles covering bass news, resources, and in-depth profiles, this site has pioneered an online community in the double bass world. His blog and podcast are highly regarded in the music world and have been featured as top offerings in the world of arts and culture for the past decade.

feeds.title: Talking Bass
feeds.description: Talkingbass is a complete social network and learning hub for bass players. Sign up today and gain access to an amazing, active community and a huge facility of practice resources. And guess what, it's totally free. The very best in online bass guitar lessons and courses to improve every aspect of your bass playing.

feeds.title: Bass Road Blog
feeds.description: Bass Road is a website where you can improve your bass guitar skills and musicality with help of online courses, lessons and resources. Bass Road was founded by Bogdan Radovic (pro bassist & online educator) in 2020. The courses and resources are tailored specifically so that you can get the most out of your available practice time, with a clear learning path.

feeds.title: Learn to Play Bass Guitar Blog
feeds.description: Sing a new song, and play skillfully with a shout of joy. Learn how to play bass with this complete guide for beginners featuring videos, tips on how to tune a bass, and how to practice the bass with us. For anyone starting out learning how to play the bass, we can help you. Check our website for all the information you are looking for.

feeds.title: Steve Bryant Bass Guitar Blog
feeds.description: Steve Bryant has recorded with top-name producers, artists and writers as a full-time bassist. Steve is now available for tracking bass remotely on your project via ProTools at home. Learn more about Steve Bryant's bass guitar methods, philosophy, and an inside look into the recording session world.

feeds.title: Double Bass Guide
feeds.description: The DoubleBassGuide has its origin in a website published in 1994. It started with a collection of information about pickups and amplifiers for double bass that already have been available back then. The author has transferred the knowledge that he has gathered over the years on the subject of double bass into a book, follow his website to get your hands on them.

feeds.title: How To Play Bass Blog
feeds.description: There are lots of bass guitar sites out there, some great ones but there's one thing that makes how to play bass dot com different from the rest. How To Play Bass is a tutorial-based website for bass guitar players where beginner and intermediate bass players come to access tutorials and learn.

feeds.title: World & Bass Blog
feeds.description: Bass Guitar Lessons for Beginners. If you are a beginner in the electric bass this is your place, in this web you will find: bass guitar lessons, bass guitar lessons for beginners, bass guitar lessons for beginners pdf, scale bass guitar lessons pdf etc. To be able to play the electric bass the first thing you have to do is to know how to tune it.Check out our lesson and learn.

feeds.title: Mastertemps Bass Blog
feeds.description: The perfect outlet to share my past experiences as a musician- anything from the mistakes I've made to the 'Aha!' moments. Regardless, if you are a beginner or intermediate electric bass guitar player looking for inspiration and answers on technique, gear, tone, and music theory to advance your playing to the next level, then you'll benefit from the content you find here.

feeds.title: Johnny Cox Music Blog » Bass
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Johnny Cox, welcome to my bass site. I've created this to be a free resource for bass players and to share some of my ideas with you. It's struck me over my years of teaching musicians, that a lot of us want to practice more. Check my blog to know how to vary practice routines to keep them interesting.

feeds.title: Bass Magazine
feeds.description: Bass Magazine is dedicated to delivering the most comprehensive coverage of all things bass. Bass Magazine is a digital publication brought to you by the team that created and ran Bass Player magazine for its first 30 years. Bass Magazine is a digital publication with daily web and social media posts dedicated to being the leading light on the past, present, and future of bass.

feeds.title: Gapplegate Guitar and Bass Blog
feeds.description: The Gapplegate Guitar and Bass Blog have grown over several years to contain more than 1,000 reviews of CDs by guitarists, bassists, vocalists, and otherwise. Check his blog where he talks about various genres like jazz and rock with guitarists and/or bassists playing a prominent role, classical music for the guitar, world music, blues, roots, electric music, and vocalists.

feeds.title: Fuel » Bass Guitar
feeds.description: Fuel formed in 1993 while playing the club circuit in and around Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. The band signed to Sony Records and in 1998 released their critically lauded, debut album Sunburn with the massive hit single 'Shimmer'. Read about bass guitar in depth in the bass guitar blogs.

feeds.title: Smart Bass Guitar
feeds.description: Smart Bass Guitar is an online bass guitar blog and publication. We talk about the most viewed, discussed and talked posts on Smart Bass and the Internet's most talked about, most raved lessons, interviews and gear reviews and more. On our website, you can find content aimed at making you a better bass player and a better musician.
